column1: # Third-party skill repositories installed per device.
# These skills live in their own git repos, so they are .gitignore'd from
# claude-config (tracking them would either bloat this repo or create broken
# gitlinks). Without this manifest a fresh clone silently lacks them and there
# is no record of what was supposed to be there -- exactly how skills/gstack
# and skills/humanizer became empty, unrecoverable directories (removed
# 2026-07-27; gstack was github.com/garrytan/gstack, humanizer's origin was
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# TO ADD a third-party skill: add its line here AND a matching entry in
# .gitignore, then commit both. Never let one exist without the other.
